TYPE 1 ZONING MAP AMENDMENT: SUBSTITUTE NARRATIVE

3710-3714 N. ASHLAND AVE., CHICAGO, IL 60613

C1-2 TO B2-5

1. This is a Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment, with administrative adjustments, to modify the current
C1-2 Neighborhood Commercial District, to meet the bulk and density standards within the B2-5
zoning. This is to allow for a new 4-story, ,21 dwelling unit (7 efficiency, 14 dwelling units) with
ground floor retail space, roof top communal deck, green roof, bike parking, and five covered
parking spaces. This Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment includes administrative adjustments to
reduce the rear setbacks, to reduce the off-street parking (project falls within a TSL rail line
station), to modify the building location standard, to modify the window transparency, and to
reduce the square footage of the commercial space.

2. 7 Efficiencies/ 21 DU = 33%, which is in excess of the 30% maximum allowed. However, the number of
efficiency units can exceed based on 17-3-0410-B Exemption.

a) The limits on efficiency units do not apply to transit-served developments within 660 feet of a CTA
or METRA rail station entrance or exit or a CTA bus line corridor roadway segment listed in Table
17-17-0400-B.

3. Additional Information for Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment:

a) Floor area ratio: 3.3. Lot area 5,380sf

b) Density: 256.19sf/Dwelling Unit (7 efficiencies, 14 Dwelling Units)

c) Off Street Parking: Five covered spaces

d) Front Setback: 0’

e) Rear Setback: 18’3”

f) East Setback: 0’

g) West Setback: 0’

h) Building Height: 44’

4. Pursuant to section 17-13-0303-D of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, follows is the additional
Information for the Administrative Adjustments:

a) Modify the rear yard setback from 30’ to 18’3” as allowed under 17-13-1003-1, rear yard
setbacks, which allow for an administrative adjustment when the proposed adjustment is
necessary to accommodate the construction of customary accessory structures or
building additions.

b) Modify the wall separation for the front setback from abutting the lot line to being on the
lot line as allowed under 17-13-1003-W.

¢) Reduce the building location standard from abutting the lot line as allowed under and 17-
13-1003-P.

d) Modify the parking to 5 off-street parking spots as allowed under 17-13-1003EE, which
allows the zoning administrator to reduce the off-street parking requirements from the
otherwise applicable standards by more than 50% when the project is in a Transit Served
Location. This project meets the TSL criteria of being within 2,354.4’ from the nearest
Brown Line Station, 1816 W. Irving Park Road, Chicago, iL

Final for Publicatio:

e) Reducing the window transparency for the commercial/office space to by up to 25
percent and modify it to 40 percent for the commercial space, as allowed under 17-13-
1003-Q.

f) Reducing the minimum ground floor commercial space from 1,345sf to 975sf as allowed
under 17-13-1003-X.
